comments.body:
as you get G3....each ship type(generic,expedition, etc) will give some certain bonus...in this case...armor specific not including bonus select "Armour Improvement"...
G3 Generic Ship - +1
G3 Expedition Ship - +0
G3 HS Cargo Ship - +1
G3 Cargo Ship - +1
G3 Armed Merchant Ship - +2
G3 Battle Ship - +4
G3 HS Battle Ship - +2

this however only for heavy(doesn't matter which heavy)...there is for light and standard...

and possible G6 bonus..but dat is kinda hard at the moment because of the high fail rate in rebuild...
